boundary: Operational and synthetic workflow evidence only; failed witnesses remain retained and same-owner passing witnesses are not independent reproduction.

records.failed_witness: A guessed shell helper was not callable in the active tool surface.
records.passing_witness: The memory registry and repository probes were completed through the current callable surface.
records.recovery: Use only the explicitly exposed execution and filesystem tools.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect callable tool metadata before selecting a helper name.
records.rollback: The missing helper changed no file, Git ref, remote, task, or authority state and earns zero credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer the live callable surface over historical helper names.

records.failed_witness: An oversized activation presentation truncated before a complete visible EOF witness.
records.passing_witness: All 3,474 activation lines were reread through EOF and the stated 44,472-word, 343,787-byte, and SHA-256 contract matched.
records.recovery: Read bounded contiguous line windows with explicit start and end positions until the final line is reached.
records.recurrence_guard: Use bounded windows for activation files larger than the output budget.
records.rollback: The presentation truncation changed no repository or route state and earns zero activation-read credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Record byte, word, line, and digest anchors while reading large batons in bounded windows.

records.failed_witness: A grouped required-skill projection truncated and obscured which files had been read completely.
records.passing_witness: Every activation-named governance skill and required schema completed an attributable exact-file read.
records.recovery: Reread each required SKILL.md, reference, and schema as an exact file through EOF.
records.recurrence_guard: Do not group large skill bodies when completeness is a gate.
records.rollback: The grouped projection earned zero skill-read credit and changed nothing.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use one exact file per bounded read when instruction completeness matters.

records.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach pipeline emitted an empty-pipe parser rejection during skill inventory.
records.passing_witness: The corrected skill inventory completed with attributable file counts and hashes.
records.recovery: Materialize rows in an array before sorting or converting them.
records.recurrence_guard: Never append a pipeline directly after a brace-delimited foreach statement in this shell.
records.rollback: The parser rejected the command before a child mutation ran.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use a materialized array for PowerShell loop projections.

records.failed_witness: The same empty-pipe parser pattern recurred during external-receipt inventory.
records.passing_witness: All three exact Elowen receipt files were enumerated and their digests were verified.
records.recovery: Replace the loop pipeline with a populated rows array and bounded JSON projection.
records.recurrence_guard: Apply the materialized-array pattern consistently to every loop projection.
records.rollback: No receipt or repository byte changed; the recurrence remains a separate zero-credit witness.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat repeated parser faults as separate negatives even when the recovery method is shared.

records.failed_witness: The empty-pipe parser pattern recurred during source-artifact sizing.
records.passing_witness: The six large source dependencies received exact byte and line counts.
records.recovery: Collect file metadata in a rows array, then serialize after the loop.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep loop production and output transformation as separate PowerShell statements.
records.rollback: The parser fault wrote nothing and receives zero sizing credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use small scalar projections for source inventory.

records.failed_witness: A fourth empty-pipe parser recurrence occurred before the guard was applied uniformly.
records.passing_witness: Subsequent loop-based manifests and file inventories completed without the parser fault.
records.recovery: Standardize every remaining loop projection on explicit array materialization.
records.recurrence_guard: Copy the already-passing array pattern rather than rewriting loop syntax.
records.rollback: The recurrence changed nothing and remains independently retained.
records.sibling_recommendation: Promote a recurrence guard only after it prevents later instances.

records.failed_witness: A broad external-receipt projection exceeded the useful context bound.
records.passing_witness: Failed-canonical, corrected-composite, payload, corrected-module, and terminal-route digests and counts all reconciled exactly.
records.recovery: Inspect top-level keys first, then project only exact scalar and count fields in separate calls.
records.recurrence_guard: Discover receipt shape before serializing nested values.
records.rollback: The overbroad display changed no receipt and earns zero evidence credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use shape-first receipt inspection and bounded scalar projections.

records.failed_witness: A combined Git verification wrapper returned no attributable output.
records.passing_witness: The source branch was clean, 0/0 divergent, fresh four-way equal, exactly four commits and zero merges, with a direct parent chain and complete anchor ancestry.
records.recovery: Decompose branch, status, equality, history, parent, and ancestry proof into scalar probes.
records.recurrence_guard: Do not award Git credit to an empty or unattributable wrapper.
records.rollback: The read-only wrapper changed no Git object or ref.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer scalar Git gates and report process handles for long network probes.

records.failed_witness: A full worktree-list presentation crossed its reporting window before its terminator.
records.passing_witness: Both exact identifiers had zero matches before the additive no-checkout worktree was created.
records.recovery: Confirm Git-process quiescence and filter only the proposed worktree path and branch ref.
records.recurrence_guard: Query only the proposed path and branch when uniqueness is the gate.
records.rollback: No duplicate worktree or branch was created by the incomplete display.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use exact filtered worktree proofs instead of printing the registry.

records.failed_witness: The first roster successor query used an unsupported owner flag instead of the documented seat flag.
records.passing_witness: The roster returned Sylven Arc to Caelen Morrow as a prepared-not-sent terminally gated main-task edge.
records.recovery: Rerun only the failed query with the exact documented --seat argument.
records.recurrence_guard: Copy command arguments from the current SKILL.md rather than inferring option names.
records.rollback: The parser error sent no message and changed no roster or authorization state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Validate state first, then query the next seat with the documented flag.

records.failed_witness: The first complete proposal-corpus projection failed at the Windows CP1252 output boundary on a title containing a macron.
records.passing_witness: The recovered projection proved a continuous 3,770-row chain, 3,769 unique normalized labels, and disclosed all domain-keyword neighbours.
records.recovery: Repeat the read-only projection with PYTHONUTF8=1.
records.recurrence_guard: Set explicit UTF-8 before Python text projections on Windows.
records.rollback: The codec fault wrote no artifact and earns zero novelty credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat explicit UTF-8 as a startup precondition for multilingual proposal corpora.

records.failed_witness: The initial carillon practice lens overlapped an inherited change-ringing and bell contract family.
records.passing_witness: The stained-glass domain had no direct family hit and supported twenty distinct mechanism-specific proposals.
records.recovery: Reject the domain before preregistration and screen alternative practice vocabularies across the complete corpus.
records.recurrence_guard: Run domain-token screening before drafting a full proposal contract.
records.rollback: The rejected carillon idea was never frozen or implemented and receives zero novelty credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat early domain rejection as retained evidence, not lost work.

records.failed_witness: Two first-draft stained-glass titles exceeded the bounded inherited-neighbour threshold.
records.passing_witness: All twenty final titles passed below 0.60; the maximum inherited score was 0.555556 and maximum peer score was 0.178571.
records.recovery: Rewrite the workload relay and Freed ID relationship hypotheses around domain-specific mechanisms rather than inherited phrase frames.
records.recurrence_guard: Screen both inherited and peer neighbours before freezing any title.
records.rollback: The rejected drafts remain zero-credit design negatives and were never preregistered.
records.sibling_recommendation: Disclose high shared-boundary scores and explain the domain-specific mechanism.

records.failed_witness: The installed roster and authorization states carried an older Lyren cursor and no phase on the Sylven successor query.
records.passing_witness: Stored topology still resolved Sylven Arc to Caelen Morrow, and the live activation supplied the exact v663-v6 and v663-v7 phase binding.
records.recovery: Retain the stale cursor as historical evidence while applying the newer live v663-v6 assignment only to the current phase and prospective v663-v7 edge.
records.recurrence_guard: Apply newest-live precedence narrowly and never rewrite older state merely to improve presentation.
records.rollback: No global roster, auth state, task, or route was mutated during startup.
records.sibling_recommendation: Reread live authority and current stored state at both startup and terminal routing.

records.failed_witness: The first full hardening CLI presentation emitted the correct payload and exited successfully, but the display layer truncated the seventy-record body, so the presentation alone was insufficient as a compact count witness.
records.passing_witness: The narrow projection reported profile sylven-v663-v6, 70 negative fixtures, 70 rejected fixtures, 14 positive fixtures, 14 passing fixtures, and valid true.
records.recovery: Retain the truncated display as a tooling fault and run one narrow read-only scalar projection from the same deterministic hardening callable without repeating any external action.
records.recurrence_guard: Project count and validity scalars for verbose deterministic fixtures; write or inspect the detailed ledger through the owner builder instead of relying on a long terminal presentation.
records.rollback: The display truncation and scalar recovery changed no repository byte, Git ref, remote, route, or authority state and earn no independent evidence credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use a bounded scalar projection for hardening smoke evidence and reserve full records for strict JSON artifacts.

records.failed_witness: The first owner-builder invocation refused before packet generation because the immutable Sylven source receipt uses the current anchors.exact_final key while the family builder only recognized the historical anchors.final key.
records.passing_witness: The recovered builder generated 69 owner-packet artifacts, a 43,630-word prepared baton, and 85 startup-plus-synthetic Method Flow records before runtime overlays were ingested.
records.recovery: Preserve the immutable x1 receipt, add a narrow backwards-compatible final-or-exact_final source-anchor fallback to the family builder, and rerun only the deterministic owner-local builder.
records.recurrence_guard: Normalize source-anchor aliases once at the builder boundary and test both final and exact_final schemas without rewriting committed receipts.
records.rollback: The refused builder wrote no credited packet; only uncommitted Sylven-owned generated outputs may be deterministically replaced by the recovery.
records.sibling_recommendation: Inspect immutable receipt keys before projection and preserve schema aliases additively at caller boundaries.

records.failed_witness: The first 54-test owner-module aggregate recorded 53 passing observations and one KeyError because the test projected maximum_prior_jaccard from the novelty-audit root while the immutable x1 schema stores maximum_inherited_score under screen.
records.passing_witness: The isolated corrected novelty test passed once in 0.151 seconds and confirmed 3,770 inherited rows, twenty candidates, zero exact collisions, maximum inherited similarity below 0.60, and all candidates below threshold; the other 53 passing observations were not replayed.
records.recovery: Retain the failed aggregate at zero module-success credit, inspect the immutable audit keys, correct only the test projection, and rerun only TestImmutableX1.test_novelty.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect immutable JSON keys before writing lifecycle projections and isolate any schema mismatch to the exact failing test.
records.rollback: The failed read-only module changed no repository state and earns zero aggregate-success credit; the narrow test correction is independently revertible.
records.sibling_recommendation: Bind tests to the inspected nested receipt schema and preserve successful observations when only one projection fails.

records.failed_witness: The first combined exact-index preflight crossed its 30-second reporting window while the orchestration projection emitted only stdout and failed to preserve the yielded session handle, leaving no attributable aggregate result after the process ended.
records.passing_witness: The decomposed checks passed 41 strict JSON parses, 19 Markdown checks, three Python compiles, a 74-file five-class zero-hit scan, three zero-finding Python security reviews, path and sparse checks, the 2,000-file budget, and exact 44,104-word baton integrity on the same candidate.
records.recovery: Confirm the exact process is no longer alive, retain the wrapper at zero preflight credit, and decompose only the same read-only candidate into bounded JSON, Markdown, Python, privacy, security, path, budget, sparse, and baton checks with explicit result objects.
records.recurrence_guard: Always expose and poll yielded exec session handles; decompose multi-scan preflight so each process stays beneath its evidence window.
records.rollback: The unattributable and decomposed read-only checks changed no tracked byte, Git ref, remote branch, route, or authority state and earn no canonical or independent evidence credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use explicit result-object projections and small exact-index checks instead of one long stdout-only wrapper.
